notes.title: Autumn Sale Discount
notes.content:
Greetings, all.

ManaTech is currently on a 50% discount during the Steam Autumn Sale.

In other news, apologies for keeping everyone in the dark concerning updates. Rest assured that we are currently working on updates for ManaTech. 

What you will be able to expect for the update will be character reworks, small changes to gameplay mechanics and a couple of new maps.

We hope to share something with you shortly in the future.

notes.title: Game Update v0.5.02 (20200410)
notes.content:
We have released an update for ManaTech, the major addition for this update is the ability to play with the keyboard and mouse.

v0.5.02

[b]Added Keyboard and Mouse control scheme[/b]
(The control scheme will only be available for Player 1, the player will be able to use either the keyboard and mouse or gamepad during gameplay)
Added mouse and keyboard functions for all menu interfaces in the game

[b]Level Adjustments[/b]
[b]The Manor Courtyard[/b]
Changed lighting to improve visibility for the level
Added background landscape

[b]Character Balancing[/b]
[b]Gizmow[/b]
Cannon Shot - Ability 2
Decreased damage to 140 (was 160)
Decreased energy cost to 35 (was 50)

[b]AI Changes[/b]
Improved behaviour for Gizmow AI

notes.title: Game Update v0.5.01 (20200327)
notes.content:
We have pushed a minor build to make some corrections that prevented the Elimination game mode from functioning correctly.

v0.5.01
Made corrections to the handling of the Elimination game mode

notes.content:
